findings.description: Every reader page was opened individually at original raster resolution, and the reader contact sheet was inspected. Identification, protocol/address, two-column flow, paragraph/note boundaries, closing and terminal source/rights apparatus are readable; no clipping, overlap or observed glyph loss.

The Mon./Conv. and Mon./Leo groups are distinct indented paragraphs with explicit TeX par boundaries. Native parent AAS212/214 and LF8995-9000/9080-9085 confirm separate smaller page-foot note blocks. Literal Chri-/note/slum and other source-order interruptions remain disclosed.
Sparse final page retains substantive ending, benediction, dating clause, BENEDICTUS PP. XV subscription and the final Epist. X citation before apparatus and colophon; the page is source-bearing.
